paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Shapley values by relative position to the probed target word. The values are averaged over the tasks.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for three different models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green)—grouped by their relative position to a probed target word, with values averaged across tasks. The horizontal axis displays the relative positions labeled as L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, where "L" denotes positions to the left of the target word (with L₁ being the closest), "T" represents the target word itself, and "R" denotes positions to the right (with R₁ being the closest). The vertical axis, labeled "Shapley value," ranges from 0 to 80 with linear increments of 20. For each position, three bars are shown side-by-side, corresponding to the three models. The Shapley values are generally low across all positions except for the target word (T), where all three models show significantly higher values: mBERT reaches approximately 60, XLM-R around 55, and chLSTM peaks at about 80. In positions adjacent to the target (L₁ and R₁), values are moderate, with mBERT and XLM-R showing similar values around 15–20, while chLSTM is slightly lower. For positions farther away (L₂, L₃, L₄⁺, R₂, R₃, R₄⁺), all models exhibit very low Shapley values, often near zero, with chLSTM occasionally showing slightly negative values. The bars are arranged in the same order for each position, with mBERT on the left, XLM-R in the middle, and chLSTM on the right, and no specific sorting or emphasis is applied to the categories.
